svg.title: Cross-run reporting with pmultiqc and MultiQC
svg.desc: Many per-run mzQC files from prideQC are aggregated by pmultiqc and MultiQC into one interactive HTML report with run-to-run distributions, outlier runs, acquisition characteristics and metric comparisons. The reporting layer displays prideQC values and does not recompute them.

text.font-family: Arial, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, 'Liberation Sans', 'Nimbus Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif
Arial, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, 'Liberation Sans', 'Nimbus Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: pmultiqc and MultiQC aggregate and display per-run mzQC files. The scientific calculations were already done by prideQC.

svg.text: The report is for inspection and cross-run comparison. SDRF refinement reads each run's summary.json, not this HTML.
